action_items: Deploy the same auth fix/configuration to production; this verification was limited to the preview environment.
Keep admin login_attempts clear before production smoke tests if the account was previously locked.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py now uses os.environ.get('SECRET_KEY', fallback), so missing SECRET_KEY no longer crashes backend startup in preview.
RegisterPage only pre-validates password length client-side, but backend rejects letters-only passwords and the frontend displays the backend detail toast correctly.
Backend logs show a recurring passlib bcrypt version warning, but hashing/login succeeded during this verification.
